Eli — thanks, and glad the demo resonated. Quick response with a proposed 'activation readyboard' to fit your asks. High level timeline (we can compress if you push):

1) Org & access (Day 0-1): create org, invite 1 admin + 1 SSO test user; provide ephemeral API key for sandbox. Owner: Rishi (Redwood).
2) Network allowlist (Day 1-3): we provide static egress IPs and CIDR blocks for your firewall. Owner: Neha (Redwood) + Biotech ops for inbound rule confirmation.
3) VPC peering (Day 3-7): coordinate peering acceptance from your cloud team — region us-west-2 OK; exchange peering request and route table entries. Owner: Neha + Biotech ops.
4) Smoke tests & metrics (Day 7-10): token throughput, latency spot checks, sample eval runs. Owner: Marissa (CS).
5) Final signoff (Day 10-14): mutual acceptance; DocuSign sign-off if procurement needs to be triggered. Owner: Rishi + Biotech procurement.

We can start org creation as soon as you confirm the admin user and SSO domain. I've attached a short checklist and will follow with peering specs.

Next steps for you: confirm SSO domain and a preferred contact for peering (name + cloud account ID).

Regards,
